bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location=***REDACTED*** load --replace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 --autodetect "$GCP_BQ_DATASET.raw_profiles" data/profiles.csv 2>&1 | tail -3

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location=***REDACTED*** query --use_legacy_sql=false --replace --destination_table="$GCP_BQ_DATASET.scored3ace95" \
"SELECT
   r.request_id AS request_id,
   r.account_id AS account_id,
   ROUND(SQRT(POW(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + POW(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6) AS distance_deg,
   ROUND(p.base_score - 0.1 * ROUND(SQRT(POW(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + POW(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6), 6) AS score
 FROM \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.raw_requests\` r
 JOIN \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.raw_profiles\` p
   USING (account_id)" 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "=== rowcount & sample ==="
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location=***REDACTED*** query --use_legacy_sql=false \
"SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) uniq FROM \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.scored3ace95\`" 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Create feature table via join transform
